data.notes: January 2026 in Goa was led by reggae/sound-system festivals, boutique electronic nights around Anjuna/Vagator, and cultural music festivals in Old Goa, Panaji, Margao, and Bambolim.

events.title: Mystic Moon Ecstatic Dance Festival Goa 2026
events.summary: Four-day ecstatic dance and world-electronic gathering at Sohum Spiritual Resort in Arambol. The announced lineup included Esta Polyesta, IZADORÄ, DJ Ganisch, Shiva Girish and WHITEDOVE.

events.title: Monophonik (Extended Set)
events.summary: BudXLoft opened 2026 with an extended all-night Monophonik set focused on techno and acid-leaning electronic music.

events.title: #GoaMassive
events.summary: DNB India brought #GoaMassive to BudXLoft with Omi, Arra, Master Mario and The Untitled One on the lineup.

events.title: Goa Sunsplash 2026
events.summary: Goa Sunsplash marked its 10-year anniversary at Thalassa Beach Boutique Resort in Ashwem. The final lineup included Luciano, Macka B, O.B.F. Sound System, Iration Steppas, Hempress Sativa, Paolo Baldini DubFiles, Prem Joshua & Band and Reggae Rajahs.

events.title: Lokotsav 2026
events.summary: The Government of Goa’s Directorate of Art & Culture presented Lokotsav 2026 with folk dances and music from Goa and other Indian states. The programme listed daily cultural performances from 6:30 PM to 9:30 PM.

events.title: Rural 2026
events.summary: Japanese festival/collective Rural came to Goa for a two-day electronic gathering at BudXLoft. The RA-listed roster included Atsushi Maeda, Dr. Nishimura, Gonno, Jane Fitz, Nao, Occa, Sunju Hargun and Zequenx.

events.title: Jasmine Sandlas - Live at The Leela Club Goa
events.summary: Punjabi pop singer Jasmine Sandlas performed a late-night live show at The Leela Club in Vagator.

events.title: Sound of Estuary 62.0
events.summary: Sound of Estuary 62.0 ran overnight at Dynamo in Vagator with MISHA from Russia as headliner, supported by SAVAA, Dark Fluid, Beat Frequency and Sawrav.

events.title: Festival de Música do Monte 2026
events.venueName: Chapel of Our Lady of the Mount
events.summary: Fundação Oriente’s 24th Monte Music Festival took place in Old Goa with free-entry evening concerts. The programme included Sónia Shirsat & Friends, Ao Naga Choir, Asad Khan & Friends, Stuti Choral and String Ensemble, Raul & Mitali and Ricardo Ribeiro.

events.title: Vivaan Handpan & World Music Festival
events.summary: Vivaan’s 10th-year edition was billed as a three-day handpan and world music festival at Bambolim Beach Resort with performances, workshops and three stages.

events.title: Stomp Experience 35.0
events.summary: Stomp Experience 35.0 was an overnight electronic party in Vagator. The lineup listed Carbon C, V Society, Rave Nine, Mirage, Zameer and Vrshaba.

events.title: Anahat Naad 2026
events.summary: Anahat Naad 2026 was a two-day Indian classical music festival in Margao. The listing named artists including Rudraksha Vaze, Dattatray Mhalshi, Mayank Bedekar, Sarang Kulkarni, Shafique Khan, Chhote Rahimat Khan and Ustad Rafique Khan.
